description: Liste des signaux sonores pour malvoyants sur supports de feux tricolores is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque. Liste des signaux sonores pour malvoyants sur supports de feux tricolores. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are liste, feux, sonore, malvoyant, module. The portal shows 1,088 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-11-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
